BY virtue of the powers vested in me under Section 14 of the Registration of Title Act, No.21 of 1998, I, the undersigned, hereby de-clare my determination as set out in the Schedule appended hereto in regard to the title to parcel of Land No. 113 of Block 03, con-tained in the Cadastral Map No. 320051, situated in the Village of Keerapane, within the Grama Niladhari Division of No. 1129 - Keerapane the Divisional Secretary's Division of Doluwa, in the District of Kandy, in the Province of Central, referred to in Notice No. 030062 calling for claims to land parcels which was duly published in the Gazette No. 1142/16 of 26th July, 2000 in terms of Section 12 of the Registration of Title Act, No.21 of 1998.
